tasks.title: Debounced search field
tasks.prompt: Build a `StatefulWidget` with a `TextField` that calls `onSearch(String)` at most once every 400 ms after the user stops typing. Cancel any pending call on dispose, and do not fire for a query identical to the last one you emitted.

tasks.title: Counter without setState
tasks.prompt: Rewrite this counter so the `Text` rebuilds when the count changes but the surrounding `Scaffold` does not. Use a `ValueNotifier<int>` and a `ValueListenableBuilder`. The notifier must be disposed.

tasks.title: Retry with exponential backoff
tasks.prompt: Implement `Future<T> retry<T>(Future<T> Function() action, {int attempts = 3, Duration delay = const Duration(milliseconds: 200)})`. It runs `action`, and on failure waits `delay`, then `delay * 2`, then `delay * 4`… between attempts. After the last attempt it rethrows the error from that attempt. A caller passing `attempts: 1` gets exactly one call and no delay.

tasks.title: Throttle a stream
tasks.prompt: Implement `Stream<T> throttle<T>(Stream<T> source, Duration window)`. It emits the first event immediately, then drops every event that arrives within `window` of the last emitted one, and resumes emitting after the window. Forward errors and the done event, and cancel the source subscription when the returned stream is cancelled.

tasks.title: Parse a route with an id
tasks.prompt: Write `Route<dynamic>? onGenerateRoute(RouteSettings settings)` for an app with `/` (HomeScreen), `/product/:id` (ProductScreen, which takes an `int id`) and nothing else. A malformed or unknown path must return the `NotFoundScreen` route rather than null, and `/product/abc` counts as malformed.

tasks.title: Re-subscribe when the widget changes
tasks.prompt: Finish `_TickerViewState` so the widget shows the latest value of `widget.source`. It must subscribe on init, cancel and re-subscribe in `didUpdateWidget` when the parent hands it a *different* stream (and not when the stream is the same object), and cancel on dispose. Show `—` until the first event arrives, and the error's message if the stream errors.

tasks.title: De-duplicating image cache
tasks.prompt: Implement `ImageLoader.image(for:)` so that two concurrent calls for the same URL result in exactly one network request, and a finished image is served from memory afterwards. Use the actor you are given. A failed load must not be cached — a later call retries.

tasks.title: A profile row in code
tasks.prompt: Lay out `ProfileRowView` with Auto Layout in code: a 44×44 avatar pinned to the leading edge and vertically centred, a title and a subtitle stacked to its right, and 12 pt of padding all round. The row must size itself from its content (no fixed height), and a long title must truncate rather than push the avatar off-screen.

tasks.title: A checklist that actually writes back
tasks.prompt: Finish `ChecklistView` so each row's `Toggle` writes back into the parent's `items` array. `ItemRow` must not own the data — it takes a `Binding<Item>`. `Item` is a struct. Do not add a view model or a reference type.

tasks.title: Search as a Flow pipeline
tasks.prompt: Expose `results: StateFlow<List<String>>` from `SearchViewModel`. It must debounce the query by 300 ms, ignore repeated identical queries, cancel an in-flight `repository.search()` when a newer query arrives, emit an empty list for a blank query without calling the repository, and never crash the collector when `search` throws.

tasks.title: A stateless stepper
tasks.prompt: Write `StepperRow`: a label, a minus button, the current value and a plus button. It must be a *stateless* composable — the caller owns the value — clamped to `range`, with the buttons disabled at the ends. Then write `StepperScreen` showing how a caller holds the state so it survives a configuration change.

tasks.title: Split a list on a predicate
tasks.prompt: Write `fun <T> Iterable<T>.splitWhen(predicate: (T) -> Boolean): List<List<T>>`. It cuts the sequence *before* every element matching `predicate`, so the matching element starts the next group. An empty input gives an empty list, and no group in the result is ever empty. Iterate the receiver once.

tasks.title: expect / actual key-value store
tasks.prompt: Declare `KeyValueStore` in `commonMain` — `expect class` with `get(key: String): String?` and `put(key: String, value: String)` — and write the Android `actual` backed by `SharedPreferences`. `commonMain` must not reference any Android or iOS type, and the Android constructor needs a `Context` the common code cannot supply. Show how you resolve that.

tasks.title: A composable that compiles on every target
tasks.prompt: Write `EmptyState(title: String, message: String, actionLabel: String? = null, onAction: (() -> Unit)? = null, modifier: Modifier = Modifier)` for `commonMain` in a Compose Multiplatform module. It renders the title, the message and — only when both action parameters are present — a button. Every import must be available on Android, iOS and desktop.
